peer_artists.name: Chien Chung-Wei (簡忠威)
peer_artists.fit_reason: atmospheric urban and interior watercolor, quiet scenes, strong tonal control. Built international credibility from a Taiwan base through IWS competitions.
peer_artists.use_as: Primary career-path reference for building international watercolor credibility from an Asian base.

peer_artists.name: Keiko Tanabe
peer_artists.fit_reason: Japanese watercolor painter, urban and travel subjects, light and understated atmosphere. Has exhibited with AWS and NWS — Japan-rooted identity with international visibility.
peer_artists.use_as: Reference for Japan-origin watercolor career with international reach.

peer_artists.name: Thomas W. Schaller
peer_artists.fit_reason: Architectural watercolor — buildings, urban light, atmosphere, quiet structural observation. Large-format architectural studies with dramatic mood.
peer_artists.use_as: Primary reference for architectural watercolor practice and aesthetic.

peer_artists.name: Cathy Read
peer_artists.fit_reason: British architectural watercolorist known for Edinburgh and UK urban scenes. Has exhibited in London and internationally.
peer_artists.use_as: Reference for building an architectural watercolor career with direct-to-collector sales.

peer_artists.name: Lian Quan Zhen
peer_artists.fit_reason: Chinese-born watercolorist integrating Chinese ink painting sensibility with Western watercolor technique. AWS member.
peer_artists.use_as: Reference for cross-cultural watercolor identity — Chinese training meeting international exhibition contexts.

peer_artists.name: Japan Watercolor Society (日本水彩画会) exhibitors
peer_artists.fit_reason: Annual national exhibition — Tier 3 credibility target. Contemporary Japanese watercolor practitioners working at the level she is building toward.
peer_artists.use_as: Reference ecosystem for Japan active watercolor exhibition community.

peer_artists.name: Alvaro Castagnet
peer_artists.fit_reason: Urban watercolor with loose, atmospheric style; strong international exhibition record built from a non-Western base. AWS signature member.
peer_artists.use_as: Reference for building international watercolor exhibition record through society competitions.

peer_artists.name: Jean Haines
peer_artists.fit_reason: Prominent UK watercolor practitioner and author. Style is loose and expressive — very different from GEGYjiji's quiet urban register. Community reference only.
peer_artists.use_as: Community reference only. Do NOT use as stylistic reference or aesthetic comparison.

publisher_matches.name: VOID

ecosystem_nodes.why_it_matters: This is the strongest immediate ecosystem for her visual language: quiet photography, sequences, books, zines, and small-scale cultural visibility.
This is the long-horizon ecosystem for international publication legitimacy.
These references help position the work as serious observational photography rather than decorative travel imagery.
These are useful for soft visibility and relationship-building before major applications.
